verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day mission" (R2, R5, R6, R8, R9, R10); "9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" ≈10 days (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe it as a 10-day mission; R3's precise duration aligns closely.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey" (R2); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported across sources as primary objective.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "evaluating the performance of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket along with the Orion spacecraft... in deep space" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: R3 phrases it this way, but SLS operates only during launch/ascent, not deep space; broader testing implied.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "life support systems" checked in high Earth orbit/deep space (R2, R3); "test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as key test objective.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as such since Apollo 17 (1972).

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1); "four astronauts... around the moon" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Core mission description in all sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "checking out... life support" (R2)

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support systems" (R3, R5); includes environmental control as part of life support
verifications.reasoning: Environmental control is component of life-support systems tested; not separately specified.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Guidance, navigation, and communications" (R3)

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1); "taking... four astronauts... lunar round trip" (R2)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II journey passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "4,067 mi" (R3); "about 4,000 miles" / "more than 4,100 miles" (R2); "over 4,000 miles" (R5); "4,000 and 6,000 miles" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources cite ~4,000-4,100 mi closest approach; 4,700 is roughly approximate but slightly higher.

verifications.claim: The four astronauts on Artemis II include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch... first woman to venture into deep space" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" (R3)

verifications.claim: The four astronauts on Artemis II include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover... first Black man to venture into deep space" / "first person of color" (R2, R3)

verifications.claim: The four astronauts on Artemis II include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen... first person on a moon mission who is not an American" / "first Canadian" (R2); "first non-U.S. citizen" (R3)

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth" (R2, R3); "farther from Earth than any humans have traveled before" (R5)

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for the Artemis III, IV, and future missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration" (R1); "clear a path for more exploration... Artemis III" (R2); "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" (R3)

verifications.claim: The Artemis III, IV, and future missions will land humans back on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "returning humans to the moon... Artemis III" (R1); "new lunar landing" (R2); "returning humans to the lunar surface" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Artemis III/IV planned for landings; future missions extend this.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman" (all listed)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilot Victor Glover" (most); "Victor Glover, who is scheduled to pilot" (R1)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "mission specialist Christina Koch" (all listed)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "mission specialist Jeremy Hansen" (all listed)
